instruction: Candid office photograph, medium shot. In a bright office meeting room with shelves of document trays in the background, two colleagues celebrate. The curly-haired man in a black blazer (R3) sits on the left side of a white conference table, smiling warmly with his right hand raised high. The gray-haired man in a gray suit (R2) leans forward dynamically from the right, extending his right arm to meet the other's hand in a high-five. The table in the foreground holds papers and a smartphone. The scene is captured with clean, bright indoor lighting and a shallow depth of field.
